record_scope_reconstruction: Mehran / Zurbatiyah road port. The restriction concerns direct Iranian and transit truck entry into Iraq, while unloading to Iraqi trucks at the terminal remained permitted.

source_checks.finding: Original Persian article expressly distinguishes prohibited outward entry of Iranian/transit trucks into Iraq from permitted delivery to Iraqi trucks at the Mehran terminal.
Original article was inaccessible in web retrieval; not used as fresh evidence.

Original archived field report page 9 provides a labelled crossing coordinate; page 10 describes document-check access. Published in 2010, so it supplies approximate crossing identity rather than a 2019 cargo-lane reconstruction.

date_scope_check.qualification_retained: R4-ME-002-D1: Confirmed through November 3 only, not a reopening or later persistence claim. The Persian customs interview was recovered in this audit as a substantive indexed extract: ordinary cargo transshipment continued, while direct truck delivery at Mehran remained suspended. This is official-interview evidence, not direct gate observation. Passenger accounts conflict and remain excluded. The November 25 general reopening account also says loaded trucks had continued to pass, without distinguishing truck nationality or transshipment; it cannot securely date the end of this direct-entry restriction. English and Persian relays of the same officials are not independent confirmations.
